blurb: Centered on the divine king, the cycle of the sun, and maat — the right order of the cosmos that ritual and kingship uphold.

events.description: Spells inscribed in the pyramids of Unas and later Old Kingdom kings at Saqqara — the oldest extensive religious literature from Egypt — guiding the king's ascent to join the gods.
events.title: Pyramid Texts

events.description: Funerary spells painted inside Middle Kingdom coffins, adapting Pyramid Texts material for non-royal dead — the afterlife democratized — and introducing judgment of the dead before Osiris.
events.title: Coffin Texts

name: Ancient Egyptian religion
